meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. I'd like to know why.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Seventeen-year-olds misremember quotations all the time. Show me the page in his essay, and give me a copy of the play.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
You should be very careful with your next sentence. Claire won, and I'll be raising that remark with the principal tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and the page of his essay you referred to along with a copy of the play. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the matter taken to the principal, which is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which got a small sign of ground because it named the exact failure she walked in angry about.
What cost ground: You brought up her daughter's old case and suggested it runs in the family, which hit her oldest wound and attacked Owen by association just as your evidence was starting to work.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you gave no times or dates; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she answered the invented quotation by asking for the page of his essay and a copy of the play, put both in front of her so she could check for herself, instead of turning to her family.
